stem: A monorepo at Gannet Works holds `network` and `app` configurations in separate folders, each with its own HCP Terraform workspace linked to the main branch. The `app` workspace should queue runs only for commits that touch its own folder. What achieves this?

choices.text: Set which directories in the repository trigger runs for each workspace
Link each workspace to a different branch, one per folder
Add a `.terraformignore` file that lists the other folder
Configure a run trigger from `network` to `app`

rationale: A VCS-driven workspace can be told which files and directories within the repository trigger runs, which is the control for per-folder runs. A workspace is linked to one branch and ignores other branches, so separate branches do not separate folders. A `.terraformignore` file keeps files out of a CLI-driven upload; it is not the setting the docs name for choosing which repository files trigger runs. A run trigger starts a run after a successful apply in another workspace, not when files change.
